title: Russia and Ukraine Declare Competing Ceasefires Around Victory Day
detail: Russia unilaterally declared a ceasefire for May 8–9, timed around Victory Day celebrations, while Ukraine announced its own separate ceasefire for May 5–6. President Zelensky stated he had received no official notice from Russia of its proposed ceasefire, and both declarations were widely seen as political positioning. Russia threatened a 'massive missile strike' on Kyiv if Ukraine violated its ceasefire terms. The Atlantic Council described the competing declarations as each side trying to claim the moral high ground with Trump's mediation in progress.

media.caption: Russia and Ukraine announce rival ceasefires around Russia's May 9 Victory Day
